description: Link related items. Edits how this queue item relates to others: which items block it ("blocked by"), which items it blocks ("blocking"), and which item it duplicates ("duplicate of"). The blocker lists are incremental — already-linked or never-linked items are no-ops and every other relation is …

addBlockedBy.description: Items (number or id) to record as blocking this one. Already-linked items are a no-op.

items.description: A queue item's per-project number (e.g. `12`, `#12` also accepted) or its full id.

addBlocking.description: Items (number or id) this one blocks. Already-linked items are a no-op.

items.description: A queue item's per-project number (e.g. `12`, `#12` also accepted) or its full id.

anyOf.description: A queue item's per-project number (e.g. `12`, `#12` also accepted) or its full id.

duplicateOf.description: Mark this item as a duplicate of another (number or id), replacing any earlier canonical; `null` clears it. Omit to leave it unchanged. While the canonical is still open, the item closes as `wont_fix`; a canonical that is already `resolved`/`wont_fix` leaves the item's status alone.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

removeBlockedBy.description: Items (number or id) to stop recording as blocking this one. Unlinked items are a no-op.

removeBlocking.description: Items (number or id) this one should stop blocking. Unlinked items are a no-op.
